survey.doc: The Survey: one ladder over the whole province, climbed by cells revealed (Docs/features/25-the-survey.md). Every list is one entry a level; their length IS the ladder.

cells.doc: The cells revealed each level asks for, rising; the last is the province bought out.

goldFloorPerMinute.doc: The least a minute of a free cell’s purse pays, whatever the kingdom makes.

freeGoldMinutes.doc: Free column: a purse of this many minutes of the kingdom’s Gold production.

freeKnowledge.doc: Free column: Knowledge, over the bar’s cap like a lump.

freeFragments.doc: Free column: relic fragments a level pays, of relics already met.

paidHeroXp.doc: Paid column: Hero XP, with the Tavern’s and the tree’s bonuses on it as any Hero XP.

freeItems.doc: Free column: an item to put in the Bag, or empty for none.

paidItems.doc: Paid column: an item to put in the Bag, or empty for none.
